# proxmox_node_rrd_image (Data Source)

Reads a node RRD graph PNG as base64 from `/nodes/{node}/rrd`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_rrd_image" "i" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  timeframe = "hour"
  cf        = "AVERAGE"
  ds        = "cpu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cf` (String)
- `ds` (String) Data source, e.g. `cpu`.
- `node` (String)
- `timeframe` (String)

### Read-Only

- `image` (String)
